description:
Take a tour of this 148± acre ranch for sale in Coryell County, Texas, offering an excellent blend of ranching potential, recreational opportunities, and investment value. With two ponds, a barn, quality fencing, and an active cattle lease, this Central Texas property is well-equipped for livestock operations while also providing a peaceful rural setting.

This fully fenced and cross-fenced ranch features two ponds, an existing barn, a water line available at the road, and an old water well and historic windmill that add to the property's character. Whether you're searching for Texas ranch land, Coryell County acreage, cattle property, or a recreational retreat, this ranch offers endless possibilities.

Property Highlights

• 148± Acres in Coryell County, Texas
• Two Ponds
• Barn on the Property
• Water Line Available at the Road
• Fully Fenced and Cross-Fenced
• Active Cattle Lease in Place
• Old Water Well
• Historic Windmill
• Excellent Ranching and Recreational Potential

If you're looking for a Texas ranch for sale with established infrastructure, productive grazing land, and recreational appeal, this Coryell County property is worth exploring.
